title: Black Belt · H1b — Star's calendar for cycle dates and testing days
subtitle: In Add / Edit cycle (Application due, Submissions due, each payment's due date) and in Add / Edit testing day, the browser's own “mm/dd/yyyy” box becomes the dashboard's calendar that Star's events use. Each field only grays out the days its save rule already refuses; no new rule. Nothing to decide: this was approved in the design review (v1.018). OK to build?

columns.label: Today
columns.note: Amber: the browser's own date box. It lets any date be typed; the save rule refuses a wrong one afterwards.

columns.label: After

items.caption: 1 · Deadlines: “Sat, Sep 25, 2027”. Application due gets wider (about 240 → 350 px) and Submissions due moves right, as in Star's events.
2 · Payment due date: still fits the 152 px column on PC; past days gray, “Past dates can’t be chosen.”
3 · Add testing day: past days gray, Star's hint “Past dates can’t be chosen.”
Tablet 820: flag: the due-date column is too narrow here, so the date is cut (“Sat, Sep 25, …”). The build should widen it or use a shorter date on tablets.
Phone 390: testing day, in the page edge to edge
Phone 390, flag: a payment's due-date calendar opens INSIDE the narrow date cell and is squashed. The build must let it span the whole plan box (or the row) on phones.

columns.note: Green: the field and its open calendar. Drawn by switching Black Belt's date field to the calendar for the pictures only (put back afterwards).

footer: Limits, as the save rules already have them (rules.js, DayDialog): Testing day: today or later (a saved day may keep its past date when edited), and after grading has started not before the first testing day (lock.minDate). Application due and Submissions due: any date up to the last testing day (no earliest date, as today). Payment due dates: today or later (a saved one may keep its past date when edited); no latest date, as today. Date of birth: see H1a.
